name: Microbiology
summary: The biology of bacteria, archaea and other microbes: structure, growth, metabolism, genetics, diversity, ecology and role in health.

topics.name: History of microbiology and germ theory
Prokaryotic cell structure: cell walls, membranes, appendages and endospores
Microbial growth: culture media, growth curves and environmental factors
Control of microbial growth: sterilisation, disinfection and antibiotics
Microbial metabolism: diversity of energy sources, chemolithotrophy and anaerobic respiration
Microbial physiology: regulation, stress responses and quorum sensing
Microbial genetics: plasmids, horizontal gene transfer and CRISPR immunity
Eukaryotic microbes: fungi, protists and microalgae
Host-microbe interactions: normal flora, pathogens and virulence
Applied microbiology: food, industrial and environmental uses
